انغلقوا (form VII)
# اِنْغَلَقُوا (inḡalaqū) /in.ɣa.la.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# اِنْغَلِقُوا (inḡaliqū) /in.ɣa.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
